newsitem.title: USA: Boeing sees no change in China relations.
newsitem.headline: Boeing sees no change in China relations.

text.p: Boeing Co, which counts China among its most important markets, expects no change in its business relationships as a result of the death of the country's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, a company spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
"The Boeing Co expresses its deepest condolences to the people of China on the death of Deng Xiaoping," spokeswoman Cindy Smith said.
"We have worked together with China for more than 25 years," she said. "We look forward to continuing to work with China's leaders to our mutual benefit."

During the past three years Boeing has delivered one of every 10 airplanes it has produced to Chinese airliners. In the next 20 years the company forecasts China and Hong Kong will need another 1,900 commercial jets valued at $124 billion.
Historically Boeing has captured two-thirds of the Chinese market for such jets.
